description.message: Notices when you are in a Google Meet, Zoom, Teams or VooV meeting and offers to record it in OpenNoteTaker. No audio ever leaves your machine.

promptBody.message: Record and transcribe it in OpenNoteTaker? Nothing is uploaded, and no bot joins the call.
